157.about: A massive labyrinth of Gelmorran ruins used by Gridanians to ferment beans for sauces and brews; in 1.0 a hub for leves and Wood Wailer behests. Much of it repeats the same circular chambers.
entrances: North Shroud at 23-18 and 20-13 (one near Camp Emerald Moss, one near the Gelmorra Ruins)
The aetheryte at Camp Emerald Moss teleports to the Cellars' aetherial gate
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode V (2017)

176.about: A mine in Black Brush, north of Central Thanalan, owned by Amajina & Sons; its surface deposits were mostly depleted and it was opened to the public. Not instanced; dungeon leves started with the Nanawa Mines Battlewarden, and behests ran here too.
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode IV (2017)

159.about: Instanced dungeon in the South Shroud for 2 to 4 players, unlocked at level 25, with a one-hour limit. Jail cells and pterocs; sealed doors open by finding photocells. A maze of optional routes, and a party faced only one of the three bosses per run.
chests: Defeat all mites in a certain area: Gladiator or Marauder main hand
Unlock all gates: Lancer or Archer main arm
Defeat the boss: the boss chest
Clear in 25 minutes or less: Thaumaturge or Pugilist main hand
Open all six regular chests: Conjurer main hand or Gladiator shield
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode IV (2017)

231.about: Instanced dungeon in the Coerthas Central Highlands, near the Boulder Downs aetherial gate and Camp Dragonhead; meant as Ishgard's bastion against the Dravanians, overrun by Imperial troopers. A full party of 8, a 60-minute limit; magitek circles needing a number of players open the doors. Part of the Grand Company quest "Into the Dark".
chests: Kill the northwest-most orobon in the Chocobo Stables
Defeat Batraal: the dungeon clear chest
Defeat Batraal in 25 minutes or less
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode VI (2017)

245.about: Instanced dungeon in the north of the Coerthas Central Lowlands, unlocked at level 45, for a full party of 8. Pools of goldbile and rooms of gas that inflict Gold Lung; four areas, three with Gold Lung. Chests held parts of the Darklight set and artifact legwear for Black Mage, Paladin and Dragoon; part of the relic quest (Miser's Mythril).
chests: Kill the far-west slug in the first poison room
Open all six chests during the run
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode VII (2017)

246.about: A raid in Thanalan: an antling nest of round chambers spread over four floor maps. Gamer Escape listed its notorious monster, the Myrmidon Princess (level 59), and antlings, peiste, sand bats and sandstorms at levels 45 to 56.

137.about: A free dungeon in the far north of Upper La Noscea, a walk from Camp Iron Lake, designed for a party of 8 at level 50 but open to any group. Introduced by the quest "Kobold and the Beautiful" (apply coblyn choler to three cauldrons). Monsters dropped keys to specific coffers, including Dragoon artifact gloves and Monk artifact legs.
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode XV (2017)

131.about: A large one-level cave system reached by the aetherial gate at Camp Bald Knoll in the far north of Western La Noscea: an open grinding dungeon with no goals or hidden loot. Named after Mistbeard, the King of Pirates.
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode XVII (2017)

132.about: An open-world leve dungeon south of Camp Bloodshore in Eastern La Noscea, named for its Cassiopeia jellyfish. Four areas around a small center with the levemete and aetherial gate; ten guildleves and behests about every 30 minutes.
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode XI (2017)

158.about: An open grinding dungeon south of Camp Bentbranch in the Central Shroud, with an aetherial gate from Bentbranch. Two floors ("rings") around a giant tree, full of black efts popular for experience at levels 25 to 30; no levemete, keys or coffers.
sources: Speakers Network, "Remnants of a Realm" episode XII (2017)
